statements.t: (NASDAQ:MLAB) (“Mesa” or “the Company”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of critical quality control solutions and life sciences tools, today announced results for its second fiscal quarter (“2Q27”) ended September 30, 2026, and issued full-year guidance for the first time (dollars in thousands, except per-share amounts).
Today we are giving full-year guidance for the first time.
We expect to add business development capacity in this division as part of the reinvestment we announced in October in an effort to drive consistent organic revenues growth.
As a result, we expect Clinical Genomics revenues to decline in the second half of fiscal 2027 and into fiscal 2028 as we de-emphasize lower-margin products and accounts.
On October 13, 2026, we announced a savings plan (the “Savings Plan”) expected to reduce annualized operating costs by approximately $9,300.
We plan to reinvest approximately $4,300 of the savings in the business to drive profitable growth, for a net annualized cost reduction of approximately $5,000.

Actions began after Board approval, and we expect them to be substantially complete by the end of fiscal year 2027, except for certain international employee exits with protected notice periods, which we expect to complete in the first half of fiscal year 2028.
We expect the Savings Plan to be fully reflected in our annualized cost structure by the end of fiscal year 2028.

The fiscal year 2027 guidance reflects the expected impact of the Savings Plan announced on October 13, 2026, net of the reinvestment described above, and reflects the lower Clinical Genomics revenues we expect in fiscal 2027.
We expect revenues growth to be uneven from quarter to quarter.
Excluding Clinical Genomics, we expect revenues to continue to grow.

We are unable to reconcile our fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA outlook to forecasted net income without unreasonable effort because of the difficulty in forecasting certain reconciling items with a reasonable degree of certainty, including income tax expense, foreign currency remeasurement gains and losses, the periods in which restructuring charges will be recognized, or potential non-cash impairment charges.
These items depend on future events outside our control, and we expect their variability to have a potentially significant impact on our fiscal 2027 results determined in accordance with GAAP.
The Company expects to fund repurchases with cash on hand and cash from operations.
We expect to report this measure each quarter while Clinical Genomics is being reshaped.
We present projected adjusted EBITDA rather than projected net income for the same reasons.
